description: Use when an agent is waiting on a transaction and has to answer «did it work, and what did it cost»: the receipt by hash with success or revert, gas used, the fee actually paid in ether, and how many logs it emitted. found: false means it is not mined yet, which is the answer a waiting agent needs. Do not use for the transaction's own fields like value or recipient (/v1/evm/tx returns both merged). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
name: evm_receipt
title: Transaction receipt
